outline.description: This chapter provides the factual foundation of the case, the nature of the crimes committed, and the procedural path from the district court's judgment to the appellate review.
subtopics: Factual summary of the November 2020 incident and Cutbank's arrest
The charges: Felon in possession of a firearm under 18 U.S.C. §§ 922(g)(1) and 924(e)
District court outcome: Jury conviction and sentencing under the Armed Career Criminal Act (ACCA)
The basis of the appeal: Evidentiary errors, procedural failures, and sentencing enhancements

outline.description: This chapter analyzes the specific Federal Rules of Evidence and constitutional principles the court used to evaluate the admissibility of trial testimony and the propriety of jury instructions.
subtopics: Rule 404(b) and the distinction between propensity evidence and intrinsic evidence regarding prior firearm possession
Hearsay and the Confrontation Clause: The admissibility of police statements and the effect of the declarant's trial testimony
Rule 403 and evidentiary discretion: Assessing unfair prejudice and confusion in the context of witness trauma
Authentication requirements for extrinsic evidence used for impeachment

outline.chapter_title: The Standard for Reversal: Harmless Error and Cumulative Effect
outline.description: This chapter explains the legal threshold an appellant must meet to overturn a conviction despite the presence of evidentiary errors, focusing on the 'harmless error' doctrine.
subtopics: The 'substantially swayed' test for harmless error
Evaluating the weight of testimonial and physical evidence against procedural errors
The 'cumulative effect' doctrine: When a series of small errors creates substantial prejudice

outline.chapter_title: Sentencing Analysis: USSG, ACCA, and Reasonableness
outline.description: This chapter breaks down the complex interaction between sentencing guidelines, statutory enhancements, and the judicial discretion used to determine a final prison term.
subtopics: Application of USSG § 2K2.1(b)(6)(B): Possession of a firearm in connection with another felony
The interaction between the USSG and the Armed Career Criminal Act (ACCA) regarding the 'greater offense level'
The role of 18 U.S.C. § 3553(a) factors in determining sentence sufficiency and necessity
Standard of review for sentencing: Procedural error, substantive reasonableness, and the presumption of reasonableness for within-range sentences
